item.description: The _quotep3 and _quotep3b functions are expecting bytes input but receiving strings, causing a TypeError when calling quote_from_bytes(). The functions need to properly handle string inputs by converting them to bytes.
item.contract: Modify the _quotep3 and _quotep3b functions to properly handle both string and bytes inputs. Ensure that when a string is passed to _quotep3, it's converted to bytes using w8enc before passing to quote(). Similarly for _quotep3b.
